headline: Singhania and Kedia reveal latest stock investments
hook: Prominent investors disclose new portfolio additions
summary: Ace investors Madhu Kela and Vijay Kedia have disclosed new equity positions in their portfolios. Kela has invested Rs 235 crore in a missile manufacturing firm, while Kedia has allocated Rs 4.3 crore into a robotics company. These disclosures follow recent regulatory filings by the respective firms. Retail investors often track these moves to identify potential growth themes.
why_it_matters: Retail investors often mirror portfolio moves of veteran market participants.
winners_losers: Data Patterns and Garuda Construction gain visibility

headline: Garuda Construction discloses AGM voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Garuda Construction and Engineering Limited has submitted the voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing confirming shareholder decisions. Retail investors holding the stock can review the approved resolutions in the official exchange filings.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate governance filing with no direct impact on share price

headline: Garuda Construction files AGM scrutinizer report
hook: AGM voting results now on record
summary: Garuda Construction and Engineering Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing completes the mandatory post-AGM compliance process for the company. Indian retail shareholders can review the voting results and resolution outcomes from the filing. This is a routine compliance update for listed companies with no direct financial impact on share price.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on share price
